_comment: Lasing basic test: 1um n=1.5 guide -> 30um ISOTROPIC dye-doped n=1.5 reservoir -> 1um n=1.5 guide (reservoir extended 20um->30um 2026-07-25 per user request, pump area widened to match). Gaussian pulse at 500nm from the left of guide_1; input/output 1Ddft sensors mid-guide; atom-level (population) sensor across the reservoir.

reservoir._comment: ANISOTROPIC dye-doped 5CB nematic (isotropic=false) — the LC version of 03_n2f_testing's uniform n=1.5 medium. Director from a Q-tensor (Landau-de Gennes) relaxation with random-but-continuous anchoring on the y faces, so the reservoir has a smoothly varying birefringent landscape instead of a uniform index. Gain unchanged: same pre-inverted 4-level dye via the sted block.
reservoir._comment_lc: 5CB (4-cyano-4'-pentylbiphenyl) at 25 C. n_o/n_e are the ones that matter here: they set the FDTD dielectric tensor (optical anisotropy eps_a = n_e^2 - n_o^2 = 0.566, since the molecules cannot reorient at optical frequencies). The Frank constants are 5CB's real values in pN and are consumed by the DIRECTOR relax methods — the Q3D path below deliberately ignores them, see lc_param.
reservoir._comment_relax: Q-tensor (Landau-de Gennes) relaxation. NOTE: LCblock._relax_qtensor runs on the openQmin-style NON-DIMENSIONAL LdG scale (A=-1, B=-12.6, C=12, L=1) and derives S_eq from it — feeding it SI 5CB constants on a micron grid makes FIRE diverge to NaN in ~10 steps and silently cache an all-zero director. So elastic_constants/S above do NOT drive this path; they document the material and would apply if lc_param were switched to a director method.
reservoir._comment_faces: Explicit per-face anchoring overrides (x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, z_min, z_max); all null so every face comes from boundary_function below. Required keys — LCblockConfig.from_dict reads them unconditionally.
reservoir._comment_boundary: Random CONTINUOUS anchoring: sinus_random_2d with n_periods=0 drops the sinusoid entirely, leaving pure Gaussian-smoothed random noise — phi = clip(pi/2 + noise_level*pi*noise(x), 0, pi). noise_level 0.5 spans the full [0, pi] range; scale 2.0 um sets the correlation length, giving ~8 smooth undulations across the 30 um face with at most ~0.11 rad between adjacent grid points (the plain 'random' function is white noise and jumps up to pi point-to-point, which is NOT continuous). Independent noise on y_min/y_max; x faces and theta left free.

sted._comment: 4-level dye starting in the GROUND state (N1_0=30, N3_0=0) -- source_pump (Ez, absorption line lbdA=0.45) must genuinely drive population 1->4->3 to build any inversion, instead of the old pre-inverted N3_0=30/N1_0=0 shortcut that left the pump with nothing to do.

source_1._comment: Plain (non-beam) Gaussian-envelope PULSE at 500nm injected at the LEFT edge of guide_1 -- switched 2026-07-24 from a focused gaussianbeam(exact2d=true) because that beam type's amplitude is a NO-OP by design (confirmed against real MEEP's own GaussianBeam2DSource.get_fields: it normalizes by dividing by a norm computed from the SAME amplitude-scaled field, canceling |E0| entirely -- only phase/direction survive), which silently broke the amplitude sweep. This plain source_type genuinely scales with amplitude. start_time=100.0 delays the pulse so it arrives AFTER the continuous pump (source_pump) has already built up substantial population inversion, to probe the actual gain rather than launching signal and pump simultaneously from a cold, uninverted medium. amplitude switched to a 4-element list 2026-07-26 (per user request, for a richer IPC/capacity polynomial target basis than 2 channels gives) -- return_quadrosource/_strip_sources splits the size.y=10.0 extent into n_strips=4 equal 2.5-unit-tall independent-amplitude point sources. 2-strip results are preserved under datasets/2strip_backup/.

source_pump._comment: Uniform 2D-area CW pump filling the reservoir's own footprint (not a guided line source like source_1) at the dye's absorption line lbdA=0.45 -- Ez polarization, orthogonal to source_1's guided Ey signal at the emission line lbdE=0.55, so pump and probe don't directly interfere in the FDTD fields. Drives real N1->N3 population transfer from a genuine ground-state start (sted.N1_0=30/N3_0=0). amplitude=200 (2026-07-24, per user request) -- between amp=100 (gradual buildup, ~35-57% inversion over 100-200 units) and amp=1000 (near-instant ~98% saturation by t~20), so this should show an intermediate, still-visible buildup curve.

pop_monitor._comment: Atom-level sensor: saves N(t) for all 4 dye levels over the reservoir; snap_interval in MEEP time units (1 unit = 3.336 fs)

snapshot_1._comment: Dense field snapshots ONLY over t=[0,80] MEEP units (dt=4 -> ~21 snaps) where the pulse actually arrives/peaks/decays (confirmed: prior dt=50 run showed peak intensity at the very first sample t=51, already down 4 orders of magnitude by t=100) -- nothing recorded in the long empty tail after that, keeps the npz well under 100 MB.
